 2026 Texas Early Voting Turnout

 Early ballots cast in person and by mail through Oct. 29
 6,827,283
 Through Oct. 29 , 2026 , 6,827,283 Texans had voted early, 35.9 % of registered voters.
 Unofficial count from the Texas Secretary of State , updated with Hill County’s own report (state’s figure: 6,826,091 ).
 That’s already more than 2022’s entire early vote ( 5,497,027 ).
 In person, 34.5 % of registered voters have voted , vs. 25.2 % at this point in 2022 .
